messages:
Ethan: Heads-up: Aurum wants a validation run 07:30 PT tomorrow. Objectives: sustained 600 qps mixed load, 20m soak, verify chat latency SLO (p95 < 180ms, p99 < 420ms) and embedding throughput (>=1200 emb/sec aggregated). They require envelope encryption via customer CMK + audit logs. Need: slim run plan, ops config snippet, and quick pricing delta. Can @Rina take infra and @Vik own the harness?

Rina: We should provision Dedicated capacity in us-west-2 with pinned GPUs. For 600 qps and their ctx of ~768 tokens we'll aim for 3 GPU-equivalents (optimistic) or 4 if higher quality model. We'll enable prefix and kv caching. Also enable embed batching at the gateway.

Vik: I'll own harness and metrics. Proposed phases: smoke (5m @50 qps), ramp (10m to 600 qps), soak (20m @600), cooldown (5m). Collect p50/p95/p99, queue depth, kv hit rate, embed batch sizes, and per-span traces. I'll tag the run aurum-1815004321. Quick load config: 
```json
{\"target_qps\":600,\"ramp_mins\":10,\"soak_mins\":20,\"mix\":[{\"type\":\"chat\",\"pct\":45,\"ctx\":768},{\"type\":\"embed\",\"pct\":55,\"batch_max\":24}],\"metrics\":[\"p50\",\"p95\",\"p99\"]}
```

Jo: Security note: CMK unwrap for each embedding batch can add 4	6ms median; remote HSMs sometimes spike. For the POC recommend KMS-proxy with cached unwrap tokens (TTL 60s) and explicit audit sampling. Also ensure customer signs KMS addendum and provides allowlisted endpoint.

Marta: Cost note: rough placeholder: 3	3 GPUs steady -> coarse $Y/hr; if we need 4 GPUs that's +33%. I'll produce a model-specific delta after Vik posts the exact model choice. For pricing, consider recommending Dedicated reserved for predictable billing.

Rina: Ops tuning to include in config: model_batch_size=14, token_budget_ms=180, kv_cache_ttl=10h, embed_batching=true, embed_max_batch=24, trace_sampling=0.05. Fallback policy: if p95 breaches or queue depth >200ms, spill embeds to quantized embed model and reduce chat sampling rate.

Ethan: Nice. @Vik schedule 07:30 PT and label run aurum-1815004321. @Marta please post preliminary cost by 17:00 PT. @Jo can you draft a 1-paragraph KMS checklist we can send the customer?

bench-bot: Run queued by Vik  id: br-1815004321, start_time: 2026-05-18T14:30:00Z, phases: smoke/ramp/soak/cooldown.

Vik: Harness queued and smoke verified. Will enable tracing headers and collect flamegraphs; will post short results thread with p50/p95/p99 and a small ops action list after soak.

Jo: KMS checklist (short): 1) Confirm CMK ownership; 2) Sign KMS addendum; 3) Provide allowlist for KMS endpoint; 4) Approve KMS-proxy access; 5) Run test unwrap. Will DM legal template.

Marta: Got it, posting cost placeholder later today. Thanks team :thumbsup:
